files.prisma/schema.prisma:
model Customer {
  id    Int     @id @default(autoincrement())
  name  String
  email String
  orders Order[]
}

model Order {
  id         Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  total      Decimal
  status     String
  customerId Int
  customer   Customer @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id])
}
